# The Well Winch

*Leland's old well shaft drops straight into Low Grad, and Rivet wants to rig a rope winch down it. Bring 15 more Adder Skins for the line, and ask Leland where the shaft can take the bolts.*

|  |  |
|---|---|
| Town | [Urbanograd](../towns/urbanograd_quests.md) |
| Category | Side |

| After | [Good Rope](../quests/rivet_good_rope.md), [The Undercroft](../quests/leland_the_undercroft.md) |

## Objectives

1. Bring 15 [Adder Skin](../items/adder_skin.md) (taken)
2. Talk to [Leland](../npcs/leland.md)

## Rewards

- 3,210 EXP
- 2,910 mesos
- +60 standing with [Rivet](../npcs/rivet.md)
- +15 standing with Urbanograd
